data.claim: Lease = one event (lease.acquired, ttl 1800s, glob list) held claim->complete; overlap is glob-vs-glob prefix at claim, narrowed to changed files only in update/hook; enforcement is at pre-commit (warn) plus a pre_tool write hook that exists for lane hooks (Claude/opencode) but the project door matcher is Bash only; 45% of lease-hold time is idle in gates/reviews; lease.overlap, merge.reconciled, DX-drift-notice are NOT built; release-at-enqueue (LC-release) is built but unused (0 events).
data.falsifier: Any listed record id missing/unbuilt claim wrong: grep lease.overlap/merge.reconciled finds code; claudehooks pre-tool matcher includes Edit|Write; lane.released_for_gate count > 0.
data.mechanism: Read services/leases, core/admission+globs, enforce/leasecheck, api/setup/hooks, swarm/lanehooks_check, mergequeue, lanerelease; folded 126863 events (1721 lease spans); git log/merge-tree probes on 100 recent merges.
data.probe: python event-log fold (spans, gate intervals, git log first/last commit); lanehooks_check timing; git merge-tree timing; ddflow metrics; grep
data.probe_output: lease hold p50 65m p90 367m (all) / completed p50 65m p90 242m; gate+review union 45.4% of hold (review 27.9, ci/unit 20.1); last-commit->merge 21.5%, claim->first commit 20.4%; merge->release p50 0.8m; lease.waiting 427 events/259 episodes; declared-glob precision 92% (88% exact files), changed files covered 97%, 29/100 tasks hold more than they change (mean 2.0x); merge-tree ~8-10ms; pre_tool lease check 3.7s per call on 108MB log; ddflow metrics: queue wait behind glob conflict p90 5.6h n=1238
data.question: How does ddflow lock files today, where do agents lose time to locks, and what exists to extend for lock-late / release-during-gates / optimistic edits?
